decision_scope: Proposal only; no resource approval or launch authority
agent_reason: Historical roughly 302 MiB single-PID RSS does not include cgroup file-cache peak, nor measure task peak. The tighter option offers only about 1.7x RSS headroom and more self-throttling; a memory/task distress event would abort, not permit automatic enlargement/retry. Choose about 3.4x RSS headroom for the first diagnostic proposal, contingent on a separate 1 GiB available-host reserve and owner acceptance. Neither alternative is proven to fit or be safe; the roomier proposal spends more host capacity and may still fail. Owner may reduce/edit budgets before activation.
